t: This is the United Reformed Church Sunday School, a building in Lewisham. It was designed by George Campbell Sherrin, a British architect who lived from 1843 to 1909. Sherrin was consultant architect for the Metropolitan Railway, and he designed many railway buildings, including Moorgate station. His other notable works include the Old Spitalfields Market and the Kursaal. So a modest Sunday school here sits alongside some much larger and better-known commissions in his career.
